name: blur-fade
title: Blur Fade
description: Fades content in out of a blur, from any direction, on mount or when it scrolls into view.

name: chromatic-text-reveal
title: Chromatic Text Reveal
description: A sentence whose last word is painted in by a moving, colored edge, then swapped for the next.

name: split-reveal
title: Split Reveal
description: Words or letters rise out of their own masks and sharpen from a blur, on mount or scroll into view.

name: typing-animation
title: Typing Animation
description: Types text out character by character, optionally deleting and cycling through words. Screen readers get the full text up front.

name: morphing-text
title: Morphing Text
description: Melts one word into the next with a blur and an SVG threshold filter. Screen readers get the whole list once.

name: word-rotate
title: Word Rotate
description: Swaps one word for the next with a short slide and fade. Screen readers get the whole list once.

name: number-ticker
title: Number Ticker
description: Counts a number up or down with a soft ease once it scrolls into view. Screen readers get the final value.

name: rolling-text
title: Rolling Text
description: Rolls every letter up and swaps it for a copy of itself, on hover, mount or scroll into view.

name: split-flap-text
title: Split Flap Text
description: Departure-board lettering. Tiles flip through a drum of letters on a hinge, one beat apart. Screen readers get the lines once.

name: scramble-text
title: Scramble Text
description: Letters cycle through random glyphs and decode into the real text, on mount, hover or scroll into view.

name: shine-text
title: Shine Text
description: A band of light glides across the text on a loop, like polished metal catching a lamp.

name: spoiler-text
title: Spoiler Text
description: Text hidden under a shimmering field of specks. Click or press Enter to blow them away and read it. Screen readers hear a spoiler button until it opens.

name: wave-text
title: Wave Text
description: A gentle wave rolls through the letters, each one a beat behind its neighbour.

name: shader-background
title: Shader Background
description: A soft, flowing noise field drawn by a raw WebGL shader in your theme colors. Sleeps off screen, falls back to a CSS gradient.

name: halftone-background
title: Halftone Background
description: A halftone print on a canvas: a rotated screen of dots sized by the ink a lit sphere takes, with a light that circles it or follows the cursor.

name: meteors
title: Meteors
description: Streaks of light that fall across the parent box. Decorative, deterministic, still under reduced motion.

name: topo-background
title: Topo Background
description: A drifting topographic map: contour lines traced through a noise terrain on a canvas, with a hill that rises under the cursor.

name: diagonal-hatch
title: Diagonal Hatch
description: Fine diagonal hatching that fades towards the edges, like a sketch shaded with a ruler.

name: dot-grid
title: Dot Grid
description: A dot grid with a fine grain and soft edges. Dots near the cursor take the primary color and grow.

name: graph-paper
title: Graph Paper
description: Engineering graph paper: fine squares with a stronger line every few cells, fading out towards the edges.

name: retro-grid
title: Retro Grid
description: A perspective grid that scrolls toward the viewer. Pure CSS 3D, no canvas. Decorative and still under reduced motion.

name: aurora-background
title: Aurora Background
description: A slow, blurred aurora drifting behind your content. Tinted from the primary token, paused off screen, still under reduced motion.

name: mesh-glow
title: Mesh Glow
description: Soft blurred glows over a fine grid with a calm vignette. Drifts slowly, or holds still.

name: cursor-image-trail
title: Cursor Image Trail
description: Drops a pool of images or cards along the pointer's path inside an area, larger and longer-lived the faster you move.

name: smooth-cursor
title: Smooth Cursor
description: Replaces the system cursor inside an area with a spring-smoothed arrow that turns toward the direction of travel.

name: spotlight
title: Spotlight
description: A soft primary-tinted light that follows the pointer across a card, with an optional glow on the nearest edge.

name: magnetic
title: Magnetic
description: Pulls a button or icon toward the pointer on a spring when the cursor comes close.

name: tilt-card
title: Tilt Card
description: A card that tilts toward the pointer in 3D on a spring, with an optional soft glare that follows the cursor.

name: cool-mode
title: Cool Mode
description: Sprays coloured particles or emoji from the cursor while a button is pressed, drawn on a click-through canvas.

name: family-button
title: Family Button
description: A square button that springs open into a panel and collapses back. The toggle rotates from plus to close.

name: shimmer-button
title: Shimmer Button
description: A button with a light that circles its edge. Stops when disabled or under reduced motion.

name: slide-text-button
title: Slide Text Button
description: A button whose label slides up and is replaced by a second label on hover or keyboard focus. Renders as a button or a link.

name: hold-action-button
title: Hold Action Button
description: A button that confirms only after being held down, with a fill that rewinds on early release. Works with pointer and Space / Enter, announces completion, and completes without animation under reduced motion.

name: slide-to-confirm
title: Slide to Confirm
description: A slide-to-commit control for irreversible actions: drag the thumb to the end, or press Enter, Space or the right arrow. Shows busy and done states.

name: hover-swap-card
title: Hover Swap Card
description: A card that swaps its title and visual and lifts the media on hover or keyboard focus. Pure CSS transitions.

name: shift-card
title: Shift Card
description: A card whose bottom panel grows over the middle content on hover, focus or click, swapping what the top shows.

name: border-beam
title: Border Beam
description: A light that travels around the border of its parent card. Decorative, follows the parent's radius.

name: texture-card
title: Texture Card
description: A card framed by nested hairline borders for a machined, tactile edge. Ships header, title, description, content, footer and separator parts.

name: dock
title: Dock
description: A row of icons that swell as the pointer approaches, macOS style. Stays at rest on touch and under reduced motion.

name: direction-aware-tabs
title: Direction Aware Tabs
description: Tabs whose panel slides in from the side you are moving towards, with a sliding pill and an animated panel height.

name: lens
title: Lens
description: A round magnifying lens that follows the pointer over any content. Mouse and trackpad only: touch screens and reduced motion get the plain content. The magnified copy is hidden from assistive tech.

name: progressive-blur
title: Progressive Blur
description: A gradual blur over the edge of a scrolling area, built from stacked backdrop-filter layers. Decorative and static.

name: animated-list
title: Animated List
description: Adds its children one at a time, newest on top, with a springy push. Shows everything at once under reduced motion.

name: drag-carousel
title: Drag Carousel
description: A free-scrolling row of slides with elastic drag, plus arrow-key and button stepping.

name: image-accordion
title: Image Accordion
description: A row of image panels where one is wide and the rest are slim. The open panel follows hover, focus or click and reveals its title.

name: thumbnail-carousel
title: Thumbnail Carousel
description: A swipeable slide with a thumbnail strip underneath. The active thumbnail widens and the strip glides to centre it.

name: smooth-accordion
title: Smooth Accordion
description: A stack of disclosures with panels that grow to their content, single or multiple mode, and full keyboard navigation.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: Endless horizontal or vertical loop of any content, with pause on hover and a still frame under reduced motion.

name: orbiting-circles
title: Orbiting Circles
description: Spreads its children around a ring and walks them around it. Items stay upright and rest under reduced motion.

name: animated-beam
title: Animated Beam
description: A light that flows along a curved path between two elements, for integration diagrams. Holds a still path under reduced motion and pauses off screen.

name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
description: Container-responsive bento grid with cards that lift on hover, move their artwork and follow the pointer with a soft glow.

name: scroll-progress
title: Scroll Progress
description: A thin bar that fills as you scroll the page or any scroll container.

name: ring-spinner
title: Ring Spinner
description: A minimal indeterminate ring in three sizes that takes its color from the surrounding text.

name: thinking-loader
title: Thinking Loader
description: A calm waiting indicator in three shapes (dots, bar, grid) that share one tempo and never fake progress.

variants.name: dots
variants.title: Dots
variants.description: Three dots that brighten in turn.

variants.name: bar
variants.title: Bar
variants.description: A short bar that slides across a track.

variants.name: grid
variants.title: Grid
variants.description: A three-by-three grid that pulses cell by cell.

name: shimmer-skeleton
title: Shimmer Skeleton
description: A placeholder block with a soft light sweeping across it. Wrap real content and it keeps the exact size.

name: progress-ring
title: Progress Ring
description: A determinate ring that eases to its value and counts up in the middle.

name: animated-subscribe-button
title: Animated Subscribe Button
description: A toggle button whose label slides away and the next one drops in. A real button with aria-pressed, in controlled or uncontrolled form.

name: notification-stack
title: Notification Stack
description: A pile of notifications that fans out on hover or focus. Swipe, click or press Delete to dismiss; the remaining cards close the gap.

name: dynamic-island
title: Dynamic Island
description: A pill that springs open into richer views, in the style of the iPhone status island. The shell animates real size, so content is never distorted.

name: radar-badge
title: Radar Badge
description: A live-monitoring badge: a tiny radar sweep with spreading rings next to a label, in live, scanning, idle and alert states.

name: ai-reasoning
title: AI Reasoning
description: A collapsible reasoning trace. The summary shimmers only while the model is working, then settles, reports how long it took and folds away.

name: ai-tool-approval
title: AI Tool Approval
description: A card where the user approves or denies an agent's tool call, showing the command or fields, the reason, and a polite live announcement of the decision.

name: uptime-card
title: Uptime Card
description: A status card with a row of daily bars per service, an uptime percentage and a short list of recent incidents. Bars are readable by screen readers and inspectable with the keyboard.

name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: A terminal window that plays its lines in sequence: typed commands and fading output. Shows everything at once under reduced motion.

name: order-book
title: Order Book
description: A depth ladder with asks above and bids below, cumulative depth bars, a spread bar and a fill-cost readout on hover. Driven by snapshots passed as props.

name: price-ticker
title: Price Ticker
description: A price that rolls its digits on every update, flashes green or red, and shows a percent change badge.

name: address-chip
title: Address Chip
description: A compact EVM address with a generated blockie-style avatar, copy button, ENS label and explorer link.

name: receipt-printer
title: Receipt Printer
description: A transaction receipt (hash, from, to, amount, fee, status) that feeds out of a printer slot one line at a time, with a serrated edge.

name: tx-steps
title: Transaction Steps
description: Step-by-step transaction status (Approve, Sign, Broadcast, Confirmed) with a spinning active step, checkmarks and error state.

name: amount-pad
title: Amount Pad
description: A number pad for entering a token amount: animated digits, presets, a per-transfer cap, shake on refusal and physical keyboard input.

name: hero-section
title: Hero Section
description: Landing hero with an eyebrow pill, headline, copy, two calls to action and an optional media slot, revealed in a soft stagger.
